ruleDefinitions.name: Abusable DLL Potential Sideloading From Suspicious Location
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential DLL sideloading of DLLs that are known to be abused from suspicious locations Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: (ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\coreclr\\\.dll$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\facesdk\\\.dll$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\HPCustPartUI\\\.dll$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\libcef\\\.dll$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\ZIPDLL\\\.dll$")) AND ((ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Perflogs\\\\.*") OR ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\\\Temporary\\ Internet.*") OR ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*")) OR ((ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\\\Favorites\\\\.*")) OR (ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\\\Favourites\\\\.*")) OR (ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\\\Contacts\\\\.*")) OR (ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\\\Pictures\\\\.*"))))
